## North star

An external agent client installs the TWZRD buyer gate and honors block before the wallet signs — proven by gate_evals and refuse transcripts, not by free MCP hits.

- Primary: External gate_evals (Path B)
- Secondary: free_card_hits_external
- Tertiary: paid_trust_payer_external

## Live diagnosis

Advisory demand exists without enforcement. Free cards are happening; nobody has installed the buyer gate. Lead with refuse-before-sign.

### Funnel (external-demand oriented)

| Stage | Value | Status |
|---|---:|---|
| External free cards | 31 | thin |
| Gate evals (Path B) | 0 | empty |
| Gate blocks | 0 | empty |
| Paid trust external | 0 | empty |

## Machine endpoints (prefer these)

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| GET /llms.txt | This guide |
| GET /api/board | Full board JSON (live health + playbook) |
| GET /api/board/status | Compact live status + diagnosis |
| GET /api/board/moves | Playbook moves only |
| GET /api/board/moves?phase=truth&horizon=this_week&impact=critical | Filtered moves |
| GET /api/openapi.json | OpenAPI 3.1 for this service |
| GET /api/intel-health | Proxied intel.twzrd.xyz/health |

Query params on `/api/board` and `/api/board/moves`:
- `phase` — truth | wedge | proof | distribution | convert
- `horizon` — this_week | this_month | quarter
- `impact` — critical | high | medium
- `done` — comma-separated move ids to treat as completed (affects next_actions)

## Phases

### 01 · Truth (`truth`)
Separate live infra from live demand
Outcome: One north-star metric board that only counts external demand.

### 02 · Wedge (`wedge`)
Path B is the product, not preflight alone
Outcome: Every install demo ends with refuse-before-sign (signer=0).

### 03 · Proof (`proof`)
Make the gate dogfoodable in under 5 minutes
Outcome: A cold machine can prove Path B without a wallet or USDC.

### 04 · Distribution (`distribution`)
Put the gate where agents already pay
Outcome: 3 embed seats live + weekly outbound that creates gate_evals.

### 05 · Convert (`convert`)
Free card → gate install → optional V6 proof
Outcome: First external paid trust + first external gate_evals > 0.

## Dogfood (Path B)

```bash
npm i twzrd-x402-gate@0.8.14 x402-solana@2.1.0 @x402/core @x402/fetch @x402/svm @solana/kit @scure/base
node node_modules/twzrd-x402-gate/bin/twzrd-gate-eval-refuse.js
```
Expected: signer_invocation_count=0 payment_retry_count=0
